content: Mintlify is the leading AI-native docs platform. Its Agent researches/plans/writes docs across multiple files, monitors codebases for changes, and AUTO-OPENS pull requests (never commits to main directly). Verification is limited to running Mintlify CLI build checks. Customization via AGENTS.md (behavior), GitHub App (repo context), and integrations (Slack/Notion/Linear/Jira). Also ships an AI Assistant (agentic RAG chat over docs) and an MCP server. Confirms auto-PR/full-set generation are mainstream, and build-check verification is the current ceiling.
